limitations: This five-file subset is intended as a retrieval and later technical-analysis fixture; it is not a standalone redistribution of the full study dataset.
The source study contains EEG recordings from infants and young children. Do not use this fixture for diagnosis, treatment, participant scoring, or clinical claims.
The subset omits the full-cohort participants.tsv and other recordings, so it cannot support cohort-level or population analyses.
The stored .set recording is unprocessed source data; no signal interpretation or processing result is asserted.
